_comment: Cerberus bench prompt set (gateway phase G6). APPEND-ONLY: never edit or remove an entry; a changed prompt gets a new name, so runs across versions stay comparable. bench_test.go pins every entry's hash.

prompts.name: code_a
prompts.prompt: Write a Go function that merges two sorted slices of ints into one sorted slice in linear time. Include a doc comment and a short table-driven test.

prompts.name: code_b
prompts.prompt: Write a Python function parse_duration(text) that turns strings such as "1h30m", "45s" or "2h" into a number of seconds, raising ValueError on anything else. Include type hints and a docstring.

prompts.name: edit_a
edit_b
proof_a
prompts.prompt: Prove that the square root of 3 is irrational. Write the proof step by step.

prompts.name: proof_b
prompts.prompt: Prove that the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared, by induction.

prompts.name: procedure_a
prompts.prompt: Give a numbered procedure for moving a Linux home directory to a new disk without losing file permissions.

prompts.name: procedure_b
prompts.prompt: Enumera los pasos para configurar una red Wi-Fi de invitados separada en un router doméstico, en español.

prompts.name: chat_a
prompts.prompt: hi! I keep putting off cleaning my desk. any quick trick to just start?

prompts.name: chat_b
prompts.prompt: ¿qué opinas de tomar café por la tarde? respóndeme corto y en español

prompts.name: prose_a
prompts.prompt: Explain in two paragraphs why a model that does not fit in GPU memory can still run, and what it costs in speed.

prompts.name: prose_b
prompts.prompt: Explica en dos párrafos, en español, qué es la decodificación especulativa y cuándo deja de ayudar.

prefill.question: In one sentence, what is the text above about?
filler: The harbour office opened at seven and the first ferry left at half past.
Every crate on the quay was counted twice, once by hand and once by the scale.
A clerk wrote the tides on a slate by the door so the fishermen could read them.
In winter the lamps along the breakwater were lit before four in the afternoon.
The ledger listed salt, rope, tar and lamp oil in the same careful columns.
When the wind turned north the small boats stayed in and the nets were mended.
Children carried messages between the warehouses for a coin and an apple.
The customs house kept its own clock, which everyone trusted more than the church's.
